Heinrich Christian Friedrich Hosenfelder (1720–after 1772) was a German-born painter who became active in Denmark. Originally from Germany, he later moved to Denmark, where he worked primarily as a painter. Hosenfelder is known for his portraits and other works created during the mid-18th century. Details about his life are somewhat limited, but he is recognized within the context of art history as a contributing figure to the Danish art scene during that period.

If you’re interested in more specific aspects of his work, style, or influence, please let me know!
